records.instruction: Build a timeline of Project Beta — what has happened so far and what's still pending?
records.answer:
Project Beta timeline

Completed / happened so far
- January 15, 2026 — Project Beta officially kicked off. Goal stated: ship a new internal tools platform by the end of March. (emails/beta-kickoff.md)
- February 3, 2026 — Design review held; design was approved unanimously. Minor dashboard layout revisions were assigned due by February 7, and backend development was cleared to begin immediately. The status tracker records Design Approved as completed on February 3. (meetings/beta-design-review.md, projects/beta/status.md)
- March 5, 2026 — Backend delay communicated: a performance issue in the event processing pipeline pushed backend completion to March 12. (emails/beta-delay.md)
- March 8, 2026 — Frontend complete, per the status tracker. (projects/beta/status.md)
- March 12, 2026 — Backend complete, marked done but delayed in the status tracker. This is also reflected in the March 13 QA kickoff note stating backend and frontend development were complete as of March 12. (projects/beta/status.md, meetings/beta-qa-kickoff.md)
- March 13, 2026 — QA kickoff meeting held; QA testing began. The status tracker shows QA Testing as in progress, started March 13. (meetings/beta-qa-kickoff.md, projects/beta/status.md)

Still pending / in progress
- QA Testing — In progress. Planned window was March 14–27, but it started early on March 13. Risk noted: the QA timeline is tight, and new bugs could push launch. (projects/beta/status.md, meetings/beta-qa-kickoff.md)
- User Acceptance Testing — Pending. Planned for March 21–25, 2026. Risk noted: UAT depends on stakeholder availability during that window. There is no source here confirming it has started. (projects/beta/status.md)
- Launch — Pending. Planned target date is March 28, 2026. Current status is not confirmed as moved, but it may slip if QA finds new bugs. (projects/beta/status.md)

Summary
Project Beta has completed kickoff, design approval, frontend completion, and backend completion after a delay. QA started on March 13 and is still in progress. UAT and launch are still pending, with the main uncertainty being whether QA uncovers issues and whether stakeholders are available for UAT.
